security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, ordinary SymPy imports, and mathematical terminology. I confirmed the eval guidance as unsafe and added semantic findings for raw parse_expr input and external product steering. No prompt injection text matching override or system-instruction patterns was found.

remediation.suggestion: Remove the eval recommendation for srepr output and document safe serialization alternatives.
Do not pass raw input to parse_expr. Use validation, restricted namespaces, and explicit allowed symbols.

remediation.issue: External service promotion inside skill instructions
remediation.suggestion: Remove product-promotion instructions from executable skill guidance or move them to marketplace metadata.

content.value_statement: Symbolic math tasks can become error-prone when formulas need exact algebraic results. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through SymPy workflows for solving, simplifying, differentiating, integrating, and generating mathematical output.
actual_capabilities: Defines symbols, assumptions, and expressions for exact symbolic computation.
Solves algebraic, linear, nonlinear, and differential equations with SymPy solvers.
Performs derivatives, integrals, limits, and series expansions.
Works with symbolic matrices, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and linear systems.
Formats results as LaTeX, MathML, pretty text, or generated Python, C, and Fortran code.
Covers physics, statistics, geometry, number theory, and combinatorics through reference files.
limitations: It does not guarantee closed-form solutions for every problem.
Generated code and parsed expressions need review before execution.
Large symbolic problems can be slow or produce very long expressions.
Some examples require optional SymPy dependencies, notebooks, or compilers.

use_cases.title: Verify Research Formulas
use_cases.description: Derive exact results, simplify equations, and document assumptions before numerical experiments.

use_cases.title: Build Scientific Python Tools
use_cases.description: Convert symbolic formulas into tested numerical functions or generated code for applications.

use_cases.title: Teach Algebra and Calculus
use_cases.description: Show exact steps for simplification, solving, differentiation, integration, and matrices.

prompt_templates.title: Simplify an Expression
prompt_templates.prompt: Simplify this expression with SymPy and explain the main transformation: [expression].

prompt_templates.title: Solve an Equation System
prompt_templates.prompt: Solve this system symbolically with SymPy. State the variables, domain, and any assumptions: [system].

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Matrix
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this matrix with SymPy. Find determinant, inverse conditions, eigenvalues, and a concise interpretation: [matrix].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Symbolic Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a SymPy workflow for this formula. Include simplification, validation, numerical conversion, and safe output handling: [formula].

output_examples.input: Simplify the square of sine plus the square of cosine.
output_examples.output: The result is 1. The explanation notes that SymPy applies the standard trigonometric identity.

output_examples.input: Find eigenvalues for a symmetric two by two matrix.
output_examples.output: The response lists the exact eigenvalues and explains their multiplicities in plain language.

output_examples.input: Prepare an integral result for a research note.
output_examples.output: The response gives the exact value, a readable derivation, and a LaTeX-ready equation description.

best_practices: Define symbols and assumptions before building expressions.
Use exact numbers, such as rational values, before numerical evaluation.
Validate parsed expressions and generated code before execution or file output.
anti_patterns: Do not use floating-point constants when exact symbolic arithmetic is required.
Do not parse untrusted expression text without restrictions and validation.
Do not rely on one simplification method for every mathematical identity.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps with exact symbolic mathematics in Python using SymPy.

faq.question: Can it solve differential equations?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for dsolve, symbolic derivatives, integrals, and related equation workflows.

faq.question: Does it support matrices?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers determinants, inverses, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, linear systems, and decompositions.

faq.question: Can it generate code?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers lambdify, code generation, LaTeX output, MathML, and formatted text output.

faq.question: Is it only for advanced users?
faq.answer: No. It includes beginner examples and deeper references for advanced scientific workflows.

faq.question: What should users review carefully?
faq.answer: Users should review parsed input, generated code, file output, and assumptions before execution.
